description_en: Checks permissions that are granted on an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS实例的权限状态
kebab_example: aliyun rds check-cloud-resource-authorized --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id rm-t4n0000 --target-region-id us-east-1 --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckCloudResourceAuthorized

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The destination region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: target_region_id

AuthorizationState.description_en:
The authorization status. Valid values:

1: authorized
0: not authorized
AuthorizationState.description_zh:
授权状态，取值：
1：已授权
0：未授权

RoleArn.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the RAM role. A RAM role is a virtual identity that you can create within your Alibaba Cloud account. For more information, see [RAM role overview]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93689.html）
RoleArn.description_zh: 角色的全局资源描述符，用来指定具体角色。详情请参见[RAM角色概览]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93689.html）
